takes.situation: The Fixer brings the news; she's thankful at once, works out what he knows, and gives more than he asks.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Your Bureau loan's paid. That clockwork collector won't call on you again.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I could cry, but not on this terrace. What do I do?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: When I telephone, call Okafor off the Office door. He'll come.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: So you know about us. What happens to him if he comes?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nothing, if this goes right. A few minutes, he never sees us.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'll say I've news that can't go on the line. He'll stay.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Say that, and nothing of us. You're with us now, Miss Nikolaou.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I see every face on that square. Trouble, and I'll warn you.

learned: Loan paid. Inez is with us.

takes.situation: The Bureau's notice reached her first, so she speaks first, agrees before hearing the ask, and ends talking unprompted.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: That was us. The loan's gone, and you owe the Bureau nothing.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Bless you. Whatever you want, I'll do it, only not out here.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: You stay here. When I telephone, call Okafor off the Office door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Nobody knows he'd leave that door for me. What happens to him?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: If this goes right, nothing. A few minutes, he never sees us.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'll say I've news, not for the line. Nothing about you.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'm with you, then. I'll warn you if trouble crosses that square.

learned: Loan paid. Inez will warn us.
